vb_textbox.text: Try to work out which colours in a pair are giving you typically more points, and focus on that colour when it appears (I felt yellow over orange, brown over blue, green over pink, purple over red felt like it worked ok). If it starts to drop in points after a few rounds, switch to the other colour in the pair. I don't think the basket colour is relevant to the score. I couldn't work out if the orientation of the coloured gnomes (left or right), or if the gnome size/shape made a difference in the reward (it didn't seem to as far as I could see). Most importantly though, be fast. Don't miss rounds and points by being slow.
